tags.name: Music
tags.description: Music library on top of Files: tracks from audio tags, albums, artists, cover art, lyrics, manual and smart playlists, favorites, ratings and plays, live audio transcodes and offline-download renditions.

get.description:
Tracks (audio files whose category is empty or `music`) across the caller's home and the libraries they can read — other users' homes only with an explicit `space_id`. Keyset pagination; `sort=random` with a `seed` gives a stable shuffle across pages. `favorite`, `rating`, `play_count` and `last_played_at` are the caller's own.

**Scope:** `music:read`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search (diacritics ignored, prefix match on the last word).

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: Tracks of an artist (album or track artist).

parameters.name: favorite
parameters.description: The caller's favorites (`true`) or the rest (`false`).

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one space the caller can read (also another user's home, for admins).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; missing values sort last. `plays`/`last_played` use the caller's plays.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Seed for `sort=random` (keep it constant while paging; a random one is chosen and kept in the cursor otherwise).

post.description:
Returns the tracks the caller can read among up to 500 ids, and the ids that are missing (deleted, trashed, unreadable or no longer music). Offline clients re-validate their downloads with it.

**Scope:** `music:read`

Applies the same manual values (as `PATCH /music/tracks/{id}`) to up to 1000 tracks; tracks that are missing, unreadable or read-only are reported per id.

**Scope:** `music:write`

get.description:
One track. Files that are unreadable **or not music items** are 404.

**Scope:** `music:read`

patch.description:
Sets manual values; re-reading the file keeps them (`probe?reset=1` drops them). Unknown and computed fields are ignored, so a GET result can be sent back. Needs write access to the file's space (403 otherwise).

**Scope:** `music:write`

post.description:
Reads the file's tags, technical values, embedded picture and lyrics again now. `?reset=1` also drops manual edits. One manual probe per user at a time (4 server-wide): 429 with `Retry-After` beyond.

**Scope:** `music:write`

get.description:
The file's bytes with Range/If-Range/ETag support and `Content-Disposition: inline` (sandboxing CSP, `nosniff`). Files that are unreadable **or not music items** are 404.

**Scope:** `music:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

206.description: Partial content for a satisfiable `Range` request.

get.description:
Transcodes the first audio stream with ffmpeg to `format` (aac = ADTS, mp3, opus = Ogg) at `bitrate` kbps (stereo) from `start` seconds. Not seekable (no Range): request again with a new `start`. At most 8 audio transcodes server-wide and 2 per user (a request waits up to 5 s for a slot, then 429 with `Retry-After`); they do not use the video transcode slots. ffmpeg stops when the client disconnects or stops reading for 60 s. Needs ffmpeg and `media.transcode_enabled` (501 `ffmpeg_unavailable` otherwise).

**Scope:** `music:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

The download source of offline clients, always `Content-Disposition: attachment` with Range/If-Range/ETag. `original` (default) is the file itself. `high`/`normal`/`low` are AAC in MP4 (`audio/mp4`, faststart) at 256/160/96 kbps — never above the file's own bitrate (AAC-in-MP4 files at or below it are served as they are) — produced once by ffmpeg into a cache bounded by `music.download_cache_bytes` (least recently used first). While a rendition is prepared the answer is 202 `{"status":"preparing"}` with `Retry-After`. The ETag changes with the source file and the quality, so `If-Range` resumes never mix renditions. Without ffmpeg or with a 0-byte cache only `original` works (501 `ffmpeg_unavailable`).

**Scope:** `music:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

202.description: The rendition is being prepared; retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

get.description:
Cover art: custom album art (set for the album in the track's space), else the embedded picture (front cover preferred), else (`music.folder_art`) a cover image next to the track. Re-encoded JPEG; 404 when there is none.

**Scope:** `music:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Longest edge: sm 160, md 320, lg 640, xl 1200 px (never upscaled).

get.description:
Embedded lyrics (ID3 USLT/SYLT, Vorbis LYRICS/UNSYNCEDLYRICS, MP4 ©lyr) or an `.lrc` sidecar with the track's base name. Synced lyrics (`[mm:ss.xx]` stamps) beat unsynced ones; between two of the same kind the `.lrc` wins. Unsynced lines have `time_seconds: null`. 404 when there are none.

**Scope:** `music:read`

put.description:
Stores custom art for the album in every space holding the caller's tracks of it; the caller needs write access to each of those spaces (403 otherwise). Art set in one space never shows on other copies of the album.

**Scope:** `music:write`

requestBody.description: Image (JPEG, PNG or GIF; at most 20 MiB and 50 megapixels; WebP is rejected with 415).

**Scope:** `music:write`

**Scope:** `music:read`

get.description:

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one space the caller can read (also another user's home, for admins).

get.description:
Tracks, albums, artists and playlists matching the query (each at most `limit`). Ordered by where the words matched (titles and names first), then alphabetically — never by corpus-wide relevance scores.

**Scope:** `music:read`

Recently added albums, recently played (by context: the album, artist or playlist a play came from; other plays count as their album, or as the track without one), the most played tracks of the last 90 days, favorite albums and playlists (each at most 20).

**Scope:** `music:read`

post.description:
Records up to 500 plays (offline clients send their queue with the original `played_at`). A play counts when `seconds_played` ≥ min(50% of the duration, 240 s) or `completed`; repeats of the same (track, `played_at`), times more than 5 minutes ahead or older than a year, and tracks the caller cannot read are `ignored`. Malformed entries are 422.

**Scope:** `music:read`

get.description:
The caller's plays of tracks they can still read, newest first.

**Scope:** `music:read`

delete.description:
Deletes the caller's plays and play counts.

**Scope:** `music:read`

get.description:
The caller's playlists and those other users shared. Counts, duration and art reflect the tracks the caller can read.

**Scope:** `music:read`

post.description:
Manual playlists take `track_ids` (tracks the caller can read); smart ones `rules` (422 when invalid). At most 1000 playlists per user (409), 10 000 items, names ≤ 200 and descriptions ≤ 2000 characters.

**Scope:** `music:write`

Raw `.m3u`/`.m3u8` body (≤ 5 MiB; UTF-8, UTF-16 with BOM or Latin-1). Entries resolve by path relative to `base_path` in `space_id` (default: the caller's home root), then as `<space name>/<path>` (the export format), then by the `#EXTINF` "Artist - Title". Only music the caller can read is added; unresolved entries are returned in `unmatched` (at most 1000).

**Scope:** `music:write`

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one space the caller can read (also another user's home, for admins).

parameters.name: base_path
parameters.description: Folder the relative entries are resolved against.

get.description:
A playlist with the items the caller can read (positions 0-based in that list); smart playlists are evaluated for the caller. Someone else's private playlist is 404.

**Scope:** `music:read`

patch.description:
Name, description, visibility, collaborative flag and (smart) rules — owner only (403 for others who can see it). A stale `base_version` is 409 `conflict` with `details.current` (the playlist).

**Scope:** `music:write`

post.description:
Inserts up to 1000 tracks the caller can read at `position` (default: append). Owner, or anyone for collaborative shared playlists (403 otherwise); smart playlists are read-only (409). Positions are 0-based in the caller's list; items the caller cannot see keep their places. A stale `base_version` is 409 with `details.current`. At most 10 000 items (409).

**Scope:** `music:write`

put.description:
Replaces the caller's list with up to 10 000 tracks in order. Owner, or anyone for collaborative shared playlists (403 otherwise); smart playlists are read-only (409). Positions are 0-based in the caller's list; items the caller cannot see keep their places. A stale `base_version` is 409 with `details.current`. At most 10 000 items (409).

**Scope:** `music:write`

post.description:
Removes the listed items (ids the caller does not see are ignored). Owner, or anyone for collaborative shared playlists (403 otherwise); smart playlists are read-only (409). Positions are 0-based in the caller's list; items the caller cannot see keep their places. A stale `base_version` is 409 with `details.current`. At most 10 000 items (409).

**Scope:** `music:write`

Moves the listed items (keeping their relative order) so the first lands at `position` in the list without them. Owner, or anyone for collaborative shared playlists (403 otherwise); smart playlists are read-only (409). Positions are 0-based in the caller's list; items the caller cannot see keep their places. A stale `base_version` is 409 with `details.current`. At most 10 000 items (409).

**Scope:** `music:write`

get.description:
The custom image, else a 2×2 mosaic of the covers of the first four distinct albums the caller can read (a single cover with fewer). 404 without art.

**Scope:** `music:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

parameters.description: Longest edge: sm 160, md 320, lg 640, xl 1200 px (never upscaled).

post.description:
Copies a playlist the caller can see into a new private playlist of theirs: the items they can read (manual), the rules (smart) or, with `freeze`, a manual snapshot of the current list. The body is optional.

**Scope:** `music:write`

get.description:
Download (`attachment`) of the caller's list: `#EXTINF:<seconds>,<Artist> - <Title>` lines and `<space name>/<path>` entries.

**Scope:** `music:read`

post.description:
Re-reads, in the background, the tags of the caller's music items below `path` in `space_id` (all their music without `space_id`). Manual values are kept. The body is optional.

**Scope:** `music:write`

download_cache_bytes.description: Size limit of the server's cache of offline-download renditions (AAC at 256/160/96 kbps, least recently used first). 0 disables transcoded downloads: only `quality=original` works.

folder_art.description: Use cover images next to the tracks (cover.jpg, folder.png, …) as album art.

MusicReplayGain.description: ReplayGain values from the file's tags.

track_peak.description: Track peak (linear; 1.0 when the file has no peak).

MusicTrack.description: A music track (a readable audio file whose category is empty or music).

album.description: "" when the track has no album.

album_id.description: Stable id of (album artist, album); "" without an album.

album_artist.description: Effective album artist: the tag, else "Various Artists" for compilations, else the artist.

artist_id.description: Stable id of the (first) track artist.

MusicTrackPatch.description: Manual values: kept by re-reads until probe?reset=1. null clears a number; other fields are strings or lists.

subcategory.description: Music subcategory (album, single, …); sets category music on an uncategorized file.

MusicAlbum.description: An album, aggregated from the caller's tracks.

MusicArtist.description: An artist, aggregated from the caller's tracks.

value.description: String (text ops), number or [a, b] (number ops), day count or RFC 3339 time (date ops); null for is_true/is_false.

MusicSmartRules.description: Rules of a smart playlist, evaluated for each caller on every read (random is stable for a day).

unavailable_count.description: Items the caller cannot read (never listed).

can_edit.description: The caller may change the items (owner, or anyone for collaborative shared manual playlists). Settings, art and deletion are owner-only.

added_by.description: User id ("" when that user was deleted).

base_version.description: Expected current version (409 conflict with details.current otherwise).

position.description: Position in the caller's list (default: append).
